2608.26951.title: Per-View Gaussian Predictions Enable Training-Free Distractor Filtering in Feed-Forward 3DGS
2608.26951.paper_summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs an explicit Gaussian representation from multiple input images in one network execution, making 3D reconstruction increasingly accessible for casual captures. However, such captures frequently contain transient objects that appear in only a subset of the views. Such content can be encoded into the per-view Gaussians associated with the inputs that observe it and remain in the combined representation despite being observed by no other input. As a result, it may produce blurred, duplicated, or floating artifacts in novel views. We introduce a training-free filtering procedure that exploits this per-view prediction structure. For each input, we exclude its associated Gaussians and render the same camera using the remaining representation, revealing content that is inconsistent with the other inputs. Feature similarity forms candidate regions, and rendering-based verification retains only candidates whose removal reduces reconstruction error in the other input views. The procedure operates on a single frozen prediction without retraining or scene-specific optimization. Across three reconstruction models and two distractor benchmarks, it consistently improves novel-view quality with varying numbers of input views. On clean scenes, evaluations across four models show that the original reconstructions are largely preserved.
2608.26951.paper_summary_zh: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting 從多個輸入影像中在一次網絡執行中重建明確的高斯表示，使得 3D 重建對於隨意捕捉變得越來越可及。<lb/>然而，這些捕捉經常包含只出現在部分視圖中的瞬時物體。<lb/>這樣的內容可以編碼到與觀察到它的輸入相關的每視圖高斯中，並且儘管沒有其他輸入觀察到它，仍然保留在合併的表示中。<lb/>因此，它可能在新視圖中產生模糊、重複或漂浮的工件。<lb/>我們引入了一種無需訓練的過濾程序，利用這種每視圖預測結構。<lb/>對於每個輸入，我們排除其相關的高斯，並使用剩餘的表示渲染相同的相機，揭示與其他輸入不一致的內容。<lb/>特徵相似性形成候選區域，基於渲染的驗證僅保留那些移除後能減少其他輸入視圖中重建誤差的候選。<lb/>該程序在單一固定預測上運行，無需重新訓練或場景特定的優化。<lb/>在三個重建模型和兩個干擾基準上，它在不同數量的輸入視圖中始終改善新視圖的質量。<lb/>在乾淨場景上，四個模型的評估顯示原始重建在很大程度上得以保留。
